subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should PR #97932 accept the persisted `announceLastRun`/`killed` recovery behavior and tool-free announce handoff once `check-lint` is rerun or cleared?
rationale: The patch has no concrete code-review finding, but it changes stored session recovery semantics and a security-relevant tool boundary, which require owner intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Accept After Lint Clears
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land the PR if maintainers agree interrupted announce delivery should be reconciled as non-running and tool-free.

options.title: Change The Terminal State
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired persisted state for aborted announce delivery, request a small revision before merge.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery Design
options.body: If maintainers want one generic inter-session delivery recovery model instead of an announce-specific marker, pause this PR and route that design first.

recommendation.title: Accept After Lint Clears
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land the PR if maintainers agree interrupted announce delivery should be reconciled as non-running and tool-free.
